text_sanskrit: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि । तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् ॥ १-२७ ॥
itrans: shvashurAnsuhR^idashchaiva senayorubhayorapi . tAnsamIkShya sa kaunteyaH sarvAnbandhUnavasthitAn .. 1-27 ..
translation: ... fathers-in-law, and benefactors; seeing all these kinsmen standing arrayed, that Kunti's son was deeply moved to pity and in sadness spoke this (as follows).
